description: This file manages node pairing requests, approvals, and state persistence for a network of nodes, including token verification and metadata updates.

methods.name: normalizeStringList
methods.description: Normalizes an array of strings by trimming and filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: buildPendingNodePairingRequest
methods.description: Constructs a new pending node pairing request object with a unique request ID and timestamp.

methods.name: refreshPendingNodePairingRequest
methods.description: Updates an existing pending request with new data, preserving certain fields.

methods.name: resolveNodeApprovalRequiredScopes
methods.description: Determines the required approval scopes based on the pending request's commands.

methods.name: toPendingNodePairingEntry
methods.description: Converts a pending request into a pending entry with required approval scopes.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads the current node pairing state from JSON files, pruning expired pending requests.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Saves the current node pairing state to JSON files.

methods.name: normalizeNodeId
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a node ID.
